body: Story mode is in: climb the all-star ladder and face Gill at the top, with an intro and ending story for every starting fighter. Versus now has stage select, plus Boss Rush, Champions Road and Mystery Fights. The settings have been rebuilt with difficulty, match rules, volumes, performance and control options, and the home screen, fighters gallery, stage gallery and move lists are all new. The download catalogue also grew to 93 items with 24 new fighters, including Captain Commando, Jill Valentine, Psylocke, Dio, Jotaro and Nakoruru.
title: Fightcade 2.5 is here
